As an invader of Earth, your goal is to EAT THE WORLD. As a super slime, everything is your prey. You start as a small, cute slime, eating barely visible things, but someone needs to be cautious. You can grow rapidly and destroy an entire city in seconds!

Super Slime is a black hole game that  can swallow everything near you! Your mouth is a black hole that swallows everything smaller than you. To eat larger things, move around smoothly like a snake and devour more and more.

From seeds and fruits…to fences, humans, trees, houses, markets, buildings, or even entire cities. Wherever you are, you are the predator of this world, and everything around you is your prey. Test the limits of how much you can swallow before time runs out.

In the end, you will have to fight against a giant monster enemy using what you have swallowed in this black hole game. Can you become big enough to battle it? Can you be the real Super Slime?

Don't forget your mission on this devouring journey! Find the target and swallow it within the limited time. It will make this eating game more exciting and intense!

Play with No WiFi! You can also play this game for free with no internet service! This offline game is perfect for killing time during a long car ride.

This addictive game capture you with its simple play and the satisfaction of destroying everything by devouring.
Through "Super Slime - Black Hole Game", become a cute invader villain and crush every city you land!
